{{Quote|Sorry, Pal&mdash;you know how I'm allergic to pain. And Captain ''Taavin'' here is really persuasive.|[[Billal Batross]]|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya]]''</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Taavin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Moog Mot VI]], he was working on bringing the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] world of [[Hollow Moon]] under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He ordered [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]] to infiltrate the Moon and disable its security network in exchange for release from captivity. Once they completed the task, Empire took control over the world. When the smugglers tried to escape aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Taavin told his subordinate not to open fire on it, saying that Han Solo served his purpose.
